verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm Kushki serves an llms.txt at docs.kushki.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, text/plain). It is a markdown docs index linking .md versions of pages, and a .md docs page (cl.md) also resolves, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs. The index is thin, though: link descriptions are empty and the .md pages embed inline HTML styling. missing for 10: descriptive llms.txt entries or an llms-full.txt, clean agent-friendly markdown content, first-party documentation of the agent docs offering.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
